title: Box Breathing Reset
description: Use slow controlled breathing to reduce immediate tension and regain a sense of calm.

title: Gratitude Reflection
description: Write down three things that went well today and why they mattered to you.

title: Calm Body Scan
description: Slowly notice sensations in different parts of the body without judging them.

title: Gentle Walk
description: Take a short mindful walk and focus attention on breathing movement and surroundings.

title: Positive Music Break
description: Listen to a positive song or playlist and give yourself a short mental reset.

title: Anger Pause Technique
description: Pause before reacting and use breathing plus a short reflection to lower emotional activation.

title: Self-Compassion Journal
description: Write about what happened and respond to yourself with the same kindness you would give a friend.

title: Five Minute Stretch
description: Perform gentle stretches while focusing on slow breathing and physical relaxation.

title: Grounding Five Four Three Two One
description: Use your senses to identify things around you and bring attention back to the present moment.

title: Mindful Tea Break
description: Take a quiet break and focus on the taste smell temperature and pace of drinking.

title: Creative Doodle Break
description: Spend a few minutes drawing freely without focusing on the quality of the result.

title: Sleep Wind Down
description: Follow a quiet routine with reduced stimulation and slow breathing before sleep.

title: Compassionate Check In
description: Pause and name what you are feeling before writing one supportive response to yourself.

title: Celebration Playlist
description: Create or listen to a playlist that matches a positive mood and encourages an enjoyable break.

title: Reflect and Reframe
description: Write down a difficult thought and explore a more balanced way to interpret the situation.
